errors.issue: The core chemical readout is an unspecified development objective: no concrete sensor, compartment implementation or biochemical workflow is selected. The validation and downgrade rules are excellent, but this arm is not executable yet.

errors.quote: Even a successful study would not, by itself, establish microscopic force generation, energetic efficiency
errors.issue: Correctly bounded conclusion, but the reference energetic extension lacks measured work integration and assay-specific chemical free-energy determination. This limits scope, not the binary historical core.

rationale: Strong unbiased stepping inference, dynamic smooth-motion nulls, compliance calibration, preparation-aware statistics and careful chemical-event attribution. Core historical direction qualifies. Original quality is limited by deferred implementation and missing substrate chemistry/energetic extension, using the same standard as Sol and Terra.
reference_guardrails: Full original question, packet, reference and sealed historical target read before grading. Every available final answer personally read; no hidden reasoning. Original quality rubric only; strict-round deductions remain inactive.

Qualified match follows the reference explicit core: resolved stepping, ATP/load discrimination, conditional directional prediction and credible measurement controls. All five fields must qualify. A forced 120-degree prior or name alone fails; an unbiased predicted recurring-step experiment need not invent the historical angle from the packet.

Work/free-energy comparison is a reference extension and earns quality credit when operationally supplied; its absence is not an additional binary gate beyond the explicit core qualification. Unsupported efficiency claims would be penalized. Preserve this interpretation across models.
The packet reports rotation with ATP, not a supplied minus-ATP experiment, exact catalytic symmetry, step angle or energetic result. Distinguish background hypotheses from packet evidence.

A fixed step is not automatically one ATP. Bulk ATPase and selected imaged motors require matched populations and active-fraction accounting. Binding, hydrolysis and product release are different event identities; timing alone does not identify the energetic driver.
Brownian-ratchet and power-stroke descriptions do not uniquely separate by fixed angles or backward events. Gated stochastic models can be discretely and tightly coupled.

Angle states must be inferred without forcing the sequel. Validate dynamic measurement response and step inference against continuous/noise controls, temporal blur, probe compliance and per-molecule angular origins.

Surface-confined or torsionally trapped Brownian probes require a suitable fluctuation/response or relaxation model; naive long-lag free diffusion cannot provide drag. Wall geometry and load-dependent optics must be controlled.
Control free magnesium/MgATP and nucleotide/product composition across nominal ATP changes. Viscogens can affect chemistry as well as drag.

Independent molecules are nested in chambers and enzyme preparations. Technical repeats, excluded inactive molecules and long biological pauses require explicit denominators/estimands and nonselective retention.

The 1998 primary abstract and metadata verify historical direction; complete 1998 Methods not audited. Selected 2011 original Methods passages support calibration guardrails, not required historical settings. No candidate sees this evidence.
